description: Rusalka, the queen of the Slavic water maidens, a pale drowned young woman with grey-white skin, very long dark green hair like waterweed flowing down to her feet, a veil of green duckweed and a crown of white water lilies on her head, a wet ragged white gown, empty glowing pale eyes, both hands reaching out to grab, eerie and menacing, floating, full body, three-quarter view, no water, the creature alone, no rocks, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
